shards.range: Complete article: abstract; Sections I–VII; Appendix; References (Proceedings of the IEEE, vol. 66, no. 1, journal pp. 51–83)
shards.note: A single coherent paper covering finite-record DFT analysis, spectral leakage, window figures of merit, a comprehensive catalog of classic and optimized windows, comparative harmonic-analysis experiments, conclusions, and transform appendix.

notes: The CMU-hosted file was verified as a complete, unencrypted 33-page scan of Fredric J. Harris's January 1978 Proceedings of the IEEE article (vol. 66, no. 1, journal pp. 51–83). Physical PDF pages map directly to journal pages by PDF page = journal page − 50. Section starts were checked at PDF pages 1 (I and II), 2 (III), 3 (IV), 8 (V), 26 (VI), 31 (VII), and 33 (Appendix and references). The first page states “U.S. Government work not protected by U.S. copyright”; the full reading copy is openly served from CMU's official cs.cmu.edu course-material path. At 33 pages, the paper is appropriately kept as one shard.
